name: @s4code/ts
description: TypeScript S4Code frontend aligned to the Claude Code framework shape.

scripts.build:sdk: bun build packages/sdk/src/index.ts --target node --outdir packages/sdk/dist && bun build packages/bridge-client/src/index.ts --target node --outdir packages/bridge-client/dist && tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json && tsc -p tsconfig.packages.json --outDir packages/bridge-client/dist/types
scripts.smoke: bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /status && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /context && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /help && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /tasks && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt '/session list' && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /mcp && bun run src/main.tsx --cwd .. --prompt /quit
